title: Règne Delta / Delta Reign is out today (Fri 6 Nov)
detail: Worldwide release is today, with Mega Rayquaza ex as the headliner; the online game got it yesterday and a Pocket tie-in set lands today. Only pre-release coverage found so far, no delay reported. Fan-site prices (ETB $49.99, booster $4.49) are unconfirmed.
source: Delta Reign Quick Facts (TCGplayer seller blog)

title: Miyata Kard Market (Réunion): single booster and displays now listed in stock
detail: Today the page shows the single booster €7.99 (6 Nov pre-order), Bundle of 6 €44.99 and Display 36 €239.99 (the last two are 2nd wave, expected 17 Nov) as in stock. ETB (€79.99) and 3-pack (€19.99) are sold out. The page's stock labels are unclear, so confirm with the shop.

title: OP-18: still no new news; Japan date 22 Nov (unconfirmed)
detail: A retailer report of Bandai's X post says Saturday 22 Nov in Japan. No English name or date announced, and no official Bandai page found.

title: Regionals Porto and Sydney are tomorrow, Sat 7 Nov
detail: First big events since the Mihawk ban. No results yet; no Pokémon event finished since yesterday. Price checks on collection cards were not run today.
